purpose: Review contract only. Do not enable training until team approval.

target.name: occupancy_ratio
target.note: UrbanEV target is suitable for pipeline validation, not Vietnamese production claims.

occupancy.note: Must come from append-only validated station telemetry in production.

temporal_calendar.note: Region-specific holiday calendar; German and Vietnam calendars must never be mixed.

weather.note: Needs station-local historical and real-time source, freshness policy and missing-value strategy.

poi_spatial.note: Static station context; version whenever OSM/provider snapshot changes.

traffic.note: Needs licensed/live source and leakage audit. Do not replace it with an undocumented synthetic proxy.

charging_sessions.note: Sensitive operational data; define consent, retention and aggregation before use. Per-session fields enable DES and residual-duration modelling only after telemetry contracts are approved.

handoff_checklist: Replace UNRESOLVED deployment_region with the actual station region.
For every candidate domain, approve/remove fields, source, granularity, timezone, freshness and missing-value handling.
Build a versioned enriched dataset and verify that every selected field is available at inference time.
For DES/RDM, define port/session lifecycle events, connector compatibility, data freshness, and the ground-truth session end timestamp.
Change only the relevant model profile enabled flag after data and privacy review.
Run temporal backtest, calibration, capacity and fairness checks before production promotion.
